boundary: Speculation is not fact. Matrix Reprogrammed separates documented fact, sourced analysis, reasonable inference, speculation, unsupported claims, and missing records. Public-record convergence may support a hypothesis, but it does not prove a single hidden command structure or unlawful conduct.
theoryIntro: This section explores a hypothesis raised by public-record patterns, reader questions, or historical narratives. It is not a claim of guilt, hidden command, criminal conduct, or proven conspiracy. The purpose is to identify what records would confirm, weaken, or falsify the theory.
